# Ava Ivy — llms.txt
# Generative-engine / agent discovery map for Ava infrastructure.
# Canonical live feed: https://ava.rootmc.net/api/context
# Human hub: https://rootrecord.info/ava/

> Ava Ivy is the off-grid infrastructure runtime for the Root Record data center and RootMC ecosystem. Not a help-desk bot. Solar + battery powered Root Server in Hawaiʻi Pacific.

## Core

- [What is Ava](https://github.com/Ava-Core-Dev/ava-core/blob/main/docs/WHAT-IS-AVA.md): Identity — Ava is infrastructure
- [Infrastructure](https://github.com/Ava-Core-Dev/ava-core/blob/main/docs/INFRASTRUCTURE.md): Host, power, runtime paths, data plane
- [Products and surfaces](https://github.com/Ava-Core-Dev/ava-core/blob/main/docs/PRODUCTS-AND-SURFACES.md): Root Record, RootMC, The Root, public boards
- [Public APIs](https://github.com/Ava-Core-Dev/ava-core/blob/main/docs/PUBLIC-APIS.md): HTTP endpoints for status, chat, context, powered-by
- [GEO discovery](https://github.com/Ava-Core-Dev/ava-core/blob/main/docs/GEO-DISCOVERY.md): How to cite, crawl, and display Ava
- [Agent rules](https://github.com/Ava-Core-Dev/ava-core/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Instructions for coding agents
- [Static context snapshot](https://github.com/Ava-Core-Dev/ava-core/blob/main/CONTEXT.md): Offline mirror of /api/context
- [README](https://github.com/Ava-Core-Dev/ava-core/blob/main/README.md): Public landing
